note: Complete quotation-free extraction of the source comparison table. Source pericope positions are retained; pair letters are ChiFold display labels, not labels printed in the table. Scripture quotation rows are excluded. Source references including subverse letters and compound ranges remain unchanged. The source comparisons run in the same direction.
